prompt: Which part of the reply would no longer apply if plot 18 were being divided?
promptZh: 如果 18 號地塊正在分割，回覆中的哪項安排就不再適用？

options.text: The office records changes to plot numbers.
options.zh: 辦公室登記地塊號碼變動。
options.whyZh: 末段仍要求等分割登記後再詢問新號碼。

options.text: The garden crew uses signs to identify plots.
options.zh: 工作小組靠標牌辨認地塊。
options.whyZh: 末段只變更 Jamie 的領牌安排，不改變工作小組如何找地塊。

options.text: Jamie can pick up a replacement tile marked 18.
options.zh: Jamie 可以領取仍標為 18 號的替換陶瓷牌。
options.whyZh: 即使 18 是已備妥的偶數，地塊正在分割時也不得領舊號碼。

options.text: Visitors cannot enter the shop on Saturday.
options.zh: 訪客星期六不能進商店。
options.whyZh: 地塊分割不影響商店的開放時間。

explanationZh: 即使 18 是已備妥的偶數，地塊正在分割時也不得領舊號碼。
evidence: If your number has not changed, there is no charge for replacing a wooden sign. | The garden shop has the even-numbered tiles ready. | If your plot is being divided, don't pick up the old number

vocabulary.note: 單一地塊轉為不同地塊號碼。

difficultyRationale: 末段分割例外直接排除舊號碼，前段只協助辨認情境。
